definition: [ שָׂטָה ] verb turn aside (Aramaic סְטָא , id. ; שְׂטָא stray ; Ethiopic III. be seduced , etc.; cf Dr JPhil. xi (1882), 205 ); — Qal Perfect 2 feminine singular שָׂטִית Num 5:19 ; Num 5:20 Imperfect 3 feminine singular תִּשְׂטֶה v Num 5:12 v Num 5:29 , jussive 3 masculine singular יֵשְׂטְ Prov 7:25 Imperative masculine singular שְׂטֵה Prov 4:15 — turn aside , of unfaithful wife Num 5:12 (absolute), + תַּחַת אִישׁ , i.e. while married, v Num 5:19 (+ טֻמְאָה adverb accusative), v Num 5:20 v Num 5:29 (all P ); of youth, from ( מֵעַל ) way of evil woman Prov 4:15 , toward ( אֶל ) her ways Prov 7:25 .
